# Medinsider

> A free, student-led website for medical students in India: verified internships, conferences and scholarships, research mentorship groups with reviews from verified students, and guidance on SOPs and CVs.

Details on every listing come from the organiser's own official page. Founded by Pavan Kalyan Mukkamula, a final-year MBBS student at AIIMS New Delhi.

## Pages
- [Home](https://medinsiders.github.io/): what Medinsider is, videos and Shorts, FAQ and team
- [Internship tracker](https://medinsiders.github.io/internships.html): internships, scholarships and research grants for medical students, split into India and International
- [Conference tracker](https://medinsiders.github.io/conferences.html): conferences and poster competitions with deadlines and fees
- [Research mentors](https://medinsiders.github.io/mentors.html): research mentorship groups (free, semi-paid, paid) with reviews from verified students
- [Privacy Policy](https://medinsiders.github.io/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://medinsiders.github.io/terms.html)
